newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean consul murdered in Russia.
newsitem.headline: South Korean consul murdered in Russia.

text.p: A South Korean diplomat in Russia's Far East city of Vladivostok was found bludgeoned to death outside his apartment on Tuesday, the foreign ministry said on Wednesday.
Ministry spokesman Suh Dae-won declined all comment on South Korean media reports suggesting North Korea was behind the murder of consul Choi Duck-keun.
Earlier, another ministry spokesman incorrectly identified the victim as the Consul-General.
"He was killed on the stairs of his apartment building by unidentified men," Suh said.
"What we know officially from our investigations is that he was hit on the head by a very heavy tool," he said. His wallet, passport, cash and other personal belongings were untouched.
There was also a cut around his midriff "made by a sharp object", Suh said.
State radio had reported Choi may have been stabbed by a poison needle, but Suh said the puncture mark was much larger than a needle wound.
The radio quoted a Russian witness as saying two Asian men were lurking in the stairwell before Choi entered the building.

It said South Korean diplomats had been warned to take extra precautions following a threat by North Korea to retaliate unless South Korea returned a submarine that intruded into the South two weeks ago.

Pyongyang has demanded the immediate return of the vessel along with its surviving and dead crew. The submarine landed an estimated 26 North Koreans, and of these 22 have been killed and one captured alive during a manhunt.
The domestic Yonhap news agency said Choi was in charge of North Korean affairs at the consulate.
"Speculation had it that Choi might have been murdered by North Koreans especially in consideration of the fact that he was in charge of North Korean affairs," Yonhap said.
Choi was transferred to Vladivostok in 1995 from the consulate in Kiev, where his son now attends university. His wife was with him in Vladivostok. A daughter lives in Seoul.
There is a small community of South Korean businessmen living in Vladivostok.
